narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms resulted in severe weather and flash flooding over eastern New York and western New England Saturday-Sunday July 17-18, 2021.
ev: Flooding conditions were observed on State Route 82 near Poole Hill Road in Ancram.
A road was reported flooded near the intersection of Barmore Road and Meadows Ridge Lane in Lagrange, NY.
Flooding conditions were reported on State Route 22 south of Boston Corners Road in the town of Ancram.
Route 9W was closed due to flooding between Glasco Turnpike and Belevedere Lane.
US Route 44 was closed due to flash flooding between Banghall and 9 Partners Lane in Washington.
Eight to ten roads were closed due to flooding around Prattsville.
